scope: All ten Table 2 pastes (nine fly ash/metakaolin geopolymers with 0, 5 or 10% Ca(OH)2 and the PC0.65 cement control), their 28-day accelerated-carbonation depths and the three MIP porosities stated in the text. Compressive strength is given only as percentage changes and is not transcribed.

materials.name: metakaolin
materials.detail: metakaolin a KAOOPOZZ series of highly active metakaolin produced by China Inner Mongolia Chaobrand Building Materials Technology Co., Ltd.

materials.name: Ca(OH)2
materials.detail: The modification effect of Ca(OH)2 on the carbonation resistance of the polymer was studied by adding Ca(OH)2, with mass fractions of raw material of 5% and 10%.

materials.name: Industrial alkaline sodium silicate solution
materials.detail: Industrial alkaline sodium silicate solution (SiO2/Na2O molar ratio of 3.28, solid content of 34.89%) was used as the raw material of the activator.

materials.name: Sodium hydroxide solid
materials.detail: Sodium hydroxide solid (purity of 99.5%) and deionized water were added to the raw material of the activator to make modified sodium silicate as the activator.

materials.name: cement
materials.detail: A group of cement slurries with a water-binder ratio of 0.65 were prepared as the control group

cures.text: The mixed slurry was poured into the mold, and then cured in a standard curing box for 24 h. To ensure that no shrinkage cracking occurs before sample carbonization, the temperature T = 20 °C and relative humidity RH = 95% were maintained in the curing box. After 24 h from mold removal, the mixtures continued curing for 28 days; then, accelerated carbonization tests and pre-carbonization compressive strength tests were conducted.

gaps: Table quotes follow the standard form; Table 2 merges FA, MK, water/binder and curing cells across each three-row group (named as spanning cells).

Compressive strength is reported only as percentage changes (e.g. 3.30–38.80% gains; losses of more than 48% after carbonation for Ca(OH)2 mixes); absolute values are in Figure 2 and are not transcribed.
Carbonation coefficients De and pH values are stated per group but have no mix-table property.
Activator mass and the water/binder basis are not stated (modulus 1.2, concentration 36%); Ca(OH)2 is dosed as a mass fraction of raw material.
Cure is recorded as sealed from Table 2's 'Seal curing'; the curing box is 20 °C / 95% RH; the 28-day continued-curing conditions are not restated.
